summary: The change only alters the degraded live-input path: when a repository batched read fails, its records are prefetched with at most four read-only reads in flight, admission stops at the run deadline, and the base-tip read is shared as an in-flight promise per repository and branch. The reads are the same per-record port calls as before (issue, pull, checks, ref) and the cooldown gate, deadline checks and per-record caching are preserved, so skip and stamp semantics are unchanged. The three added fake-port regressions cover bounded concurrency and shared base-tip reads, failed reads never counting as unchanged, and the deadline cut.

evidence: src/repair/loop-live-inputs.ts lines 116-132 admit an unavailable repository fallback reads with at most four in flight and stop admitting reads at the run deadline, directly replacing the serial per-record fallback round trips named as a likely cause in the issue.
src/repair/loop-live-inputs.ts lines 277-292 cache the in-flight base-tip read, so all fallback records of one repository and branch share one readRef observation instead of one request per record.

tests/repair/loop-input-gate_test.ts lines 343-475 add fake-port regressions for the bounded concurrent fallback, shared failed and successful base-tip observations, failed reads never treated as unchanged inputs, and the deadline cut with no post-deadline stamp write.

No throughput threshold in src/host/throughput-watchdog-thresholds.ts was raised and no review, CI or accounting gate is touched; the issue own outcome rule defers the measured 8 minute verification to a re-evaluation after 10 cycles on a newer runtime.
